texts: The primary goal of off-pump coronary bypass is to decrease morbidity and mortality: D is the answer.
It avoids the inflammatory and embolic effects of cardiopulmonary bypass and, with careful technique, manipulation of the aorta.
It does not aim at more grafts, all-arterial grafting, lower cost or more referrals.
Memory hook: the fans keep turning, the pump truck sleeps, and the coffin-maker yawns with one small coffin left.
